changes: Chapter content and recovery reads share an owned 10-second deadline covering headers and JSON bodies; cancellation, failure, scope change and superseding reads preserve existing content and never replay writes.

A cancellable chapter-loading state and clear Chinese/English timeout feedback replace indefinite loading. Complete same-path content/recovery responses are validated before applying state; recovery reads are not silently bypassed.

Workspace restore resolves the final target before reading. Actual same-target and alternate-target comparisons reduced content/recovery requests from four to two; no startup-speed percentage is claimed.
Cancelled or failed opening returns false. An actually enabled optional writing ritual was verified not to open after cancellation; existing unsaved text and editor undo/redo survive cancellation.

39 isolated headless cases passed: 12 chapter-read cases, five restored-workspace cases, 12 save/format regressions, six save-verification deadlines and four read-only snapshot regressions. No model calls.

Local Preview / PARTIAL. Native GUI/physical IME/DPI/voice/cloud AI not newly verified. No dependency, schema, migration, user-data location, shortcut, Git commit/push or new public release; old local 2.24.25 and public batch 2.24.23 retained.
runtime_validation: Preview / PARTIAL: see the current delivery evidence; headless browser, local checks, real Codex/MCP and packaged workers are separate gates. No native GUI/IME/DPI acceptance is claimed.
features: Character assistants, Python SDK and Codex MCP reuse one typed Action Registry and existing domain services.
On-demand Python Control uses genuine CPython WASI in a bounded owned subprocess, without host project mounts, network or shell.
Real frontend receipts support chapter navigation, pinned references, layouts and actual editor state.
Project/persona-scoped scripts, output history, AI task provenance and explicit read-only result handoffs.
Existing Codex login, concrete models and supported effort/context controls; real task events, result reading, cancellation and supported live steering.
Frozen author confirmations remain valid after a model or Python turn ends; scripts are never automatically replayed.
Source and binary candidates exclude private manuscripts, credentials, conversation history and character assets.
Preview: the action catalog covers designated workflows, not every application operation; new controls primarily support Chinese and English.
